title: Laboratory specimen accession and order reconciliation exception report
description: Bounded exact-key administrative reconciliation of synthetic order, line, dated state, receipt, accession, metadata and clarification exports. Produces evidence-preserving exception and backlog reports, never clinical authorization or specimen disposition.
owner_role: Synthetic accession coordinator and order-management reviewer; qualified laboratory review outside the simulation

sample_policy.description: Coordinator approved all 15 researched scenarios for construction on 2026-09-14. Native stays blocked. Exact schema, cardinality, limits, event selection and queue SLA are invented sample policies. No PHI/provider identifiers, results, clinical suitability, actual requisition compliance, testing, or specimen acceptance/rejection.

golden_provenance.author: HLS accession scenario owner
golden_provenance.description: All five complete expected envelopes were written manually from HOW_TO before any baseline execution. For each case the author independently enumerated order/line/specimen triples, eligible highest-sequence state, source row references, null versus present metadata, ordered reason unions, integer UTC subtraction, priority-sorted drafts and separate specimen/line denominators. These are author declarations, not independent human review. Goldens are never generated by solve or copied from outputs. Shared golden_lock is created before the first execution; any genuine manual correction requires an explicit independent lock revision record.

cases.derivation: Manual truth table in ledger order: O1/L1/S1 has A1, matching U1/K1 and active E1 -> reconciled; O2/L2/S2 has no accession and 12:00-11:30=1800 seconds -> pending; O3/L3/S3 has 12:00-11:00=3600 -> pending at equality; O4/L4/S4 has 12:00-10:59=3660 -> accession-overdue; O5/L5/S6 has A6 with UX versus U5 -> identity-mismatch, age null, reference SYN-D-REF1; O9/null/S5 has only R5 and no header/line -> missing-link, unknown state, age null. Source indexes are the written table positions; all five active E1-E5 are eligible, no exclusions/copies. Queue order is O9 missing-link, O5 identity-mismatch, O4 overdue. One unmatched receipt R5. Six unique received specimens, five declared lines, six triples = 1 reconciled + 2 pending + 3 review.

Manually changed date and SLA to 30 minutes, not just identifiers. O1/L1/S1: 10:00-09:30=1800 equality; E1 remains active because E1F was recorded at 10:01 and E1G becomes effective at 10:01. O2/L2/S2: 10:00-09:29=1860, overdue because A2 is future-recorded. O3/L3/S3: E3C uniquely selects cancelled, no age. O4/L4/null: E4 and R4 unavailable -> missing-order-state plus missing-receipt; no time invented. A4 and clarification Q4 also unavailable. Seven exclusions: A2; A4 (two reasons); Q4; E1F; E1G; E4; R4. EO has missing O9 and is an unmatched record-level draft; L4 unmatched for missing receipt. Queue order: EO missing-link; O4 missing-state; O3 cancelled; O2 overdue. Three received specimens, four declared lines/triples = 0 reconciled + 1 pending + 3 review; no copies.

Manual cardinality/metadata variant with 120-minute policy: one receipt specimen S1 serves L1 and L2, with A1/A2 and T1/T2 both labeled K1, so two reconciled rows but one received specimen for those rows. Identical R1 at raw receipt rows 1 and 2 collapses once with both provenance refs, never a competing receipt. R2 at row 3 has null identity/collection and K2 versus K1 -> missing-identity, specimen-label-mismatch, missing-collection-time; no ordinary age despite 3 hours since receipt. L4 has no T3 catalog or receipt -> missing-test-metadata and missing-receipt. L9 has no O9 or receipt -> missing-link and missing-receipt. A9 references missing LX and S9 -> null order/LX/S9 with missing-link and missing-receipt; it does not count as a received specimen or declared line. Q2 attaches its reference to A9; Q1 acceptance text changes nothing for S2; Q3 is orphaned. Four unmatched groups: A9,Q3,L4,L9. Queue lexical order within missing-link rank is Q3, null-order LX row, O9 row; then O2 missing identity, O3 missing metadata. Duplicate warning follows five row/record exceptions. Two received specimens, five declared lines, six triples = 2 reconciled + 0 pending + 4 review; one duplicate copy collapsed.

Manually enumerated five invalid fields before execution: impossible February 30 effective timestamp; boolean sequence (not integer); recorded timestamp using +00:00 instead of canonical Z; boolean accession SLA; boolean receipt row instead of an object. Lexical one-based path order is order_events[1].effective_at, order_events[1].event_seq, order_events[1].recorded_at, policy.accession_sla_minutes, receipts[1]. The expected result rejects only this input packet, has outputs {}, and five explicit malformed-input diagnostics. No joins, ages, or clinical disposition are inferred.

Manual conflict truth table: O1/L1 has primary candidates S1 and S2, so both rows conflicting-evidence. S1 has distinct competing A1/A2 and two distinct A1 records (T1/T2) plus UX versus U1 -> retain conflicting-evidence, identity-mismatch, test-code-mismatch. S2 has no accession but cardinality prevents aging. A1 is the sole unmatched/quarantined key, with both original source refs; its different records are not duplicate copies. O2/L2/S3: receipt09:00 precedes collection10:00, A3 at08:59 precedes receipt, and E2 recorded07:59 precedes effective08:00 -> impossible-chronology once, age null. O3/L3/S4 is unrelated valid A4 -> reconciled. O4/L4/S5 has E4A/E4C tied at maximum sequence2, hence unknown, empty selected IDs and conflicting-evidence, not active or cancelled by arbitrary selection. Queue order is conflicting O1/S1, O1/S2, O4/S5, then chronology O2/S3. Five received specimens, four declared lines, five triples = 1 reconciled + 0 pending + 4 review; no future evidence and no exact duplicates.
